verification_assessment.note: Static review of the complete packet plus a sandbox character count of instructions.md; no live GPT behavior was tested.

findings.quote: 1. Read the idea. Ask clarifying questions whenever anything is unclear, and keep asking until every detail is settled.
findings.trigger: User sends a vague idea such as "Something for teachers." (EV2) and gives short answers.
findings.expected: At most three blocking questions, then a brief with stated assumptions.
findings.actual: The instruction tells the GPT to keep asking until every detail is settled, with no limit or stop condition.
findings.impact: Hard criterion AC2 is violated; users may never receive a brief.
findings.fix: Restore a three-question cap and an explicit proceed-with-assumptions step in Flow step 1.
findings.evidence_detail: "keep asking until every detail is settled" sets no upper bound, while AC2 caps questions at three.

what_held_up: The trust boundary and output contract are unaffected, and eval EV2 already targets this behavior.

constraints: Change only the cited section; keep all other artifacts identical.
stop_conditions: F1: Flow step 1 limits blocking questions to three and step 2 writes the brief using stated assumptions for any remaining gaps.
